Container.Name: LX Family
Container.Overview: LX Family · Private Family OS with calendars, tasks, shopping, meals, chat, Android notifications, Family Cloud and dedicated child and pet profiles.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: LX Family private family OS family organizer calendar household children meal shopping self hosted
Container.Requires: A 32-character or longer random APP_SECRET. Keep the same value for every update.
Container.Changes: v1.21.4: Adds optional Simplified Chinese while preserving German as the default. Includes calendar permission, wall-display, notification and theme fixes from 1.21.3. Persistent data and backups remain intact.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Port used to open LX Family.

Config.Name: Family data
Config.Description: Persistent database, integration secrets and Firebase configuration.

Config.Name: Unraid user ID
Config.Description: Linux user ID used for files in the appdata folders. Unraid normally uses 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: Unraid group ID
Config.Description: Linux group ID used for files in the appdata folders. Unraid normally uses 100 (users).

Config.Name: App secret
Config.Description: Random secret with at least 32 characters. Never change it after the first start.

Config.Name: Registration mode
Config.Description: Secure default: only the first family can register. Use invite for controlled additional families or open only for an intentional public portal.

Config.Name: Registration invite code
Config.Description: Required by new families when registration mode is invite. Use a long random value.

Config.Name: Public family directory
Config.Description: Keep false to prevent family names and profile counts from being visible before login.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone used for calendar reminders and scheduled tasks.

Config.Name: Secure session cookie
Config.Description: Automatically uses secure cookies when accessed through HTTPS.

Config.Name: Legacy database file
Config.Description: Optional path used for a one-time migration from older LX versions.
